# manimkit

> Agent kit for Manim: skills, a searchable corpus of working ManimCE scenes, and a render-and-inspect loop


## Pages in this subsection

- [manimkit](manimkit.html.md): manimkit — make Manim (Community Edition) animations with an AI agent.
- [manimkit.corpus](manimkit.corpus.html.md): The example corpus: working ManimCE scenes an agent can retrieve and adapt.
- [manimkit.lint](manimkit.lint.html.md): Static checks for the mistakes LLMs make most when writing ManimCE code.
- [manimkit.reads](manimkit.reads.html.md): What a render read: the files and folders a scene opens, recorded as it runs.
- [manimkit.render](manimkit.render.html.md): Render a scene, look at it, and say concisely what went wrong.
- [manimkit.requirements](manimkit.requirements.html.md): What rendering needs, whether you have it, and how to get what is missing.
- [manimkit.search](manimkit.search.html.md): Retrieval over the example corpus.
- [manimkit.tools](manimkit.tools.html.md): CLI-shaped wrappers: each returns the text an agent (or a human) reads.

## Optional

- [Top-level llms.txt](../llms.txt): Complete documentation index.
